target: Mojave 10.14 / Darwin 18, disposable guest clones only

rendering.engine: Namespaced original CoreUI with 82 private Objective-C class names
rendering.fallback: Mojave rendering for unsupported widgets; failed legacy draws are discarded
rendering.images: Public and private NSImage factories plus native CUICatalog/CUINamedImage bridging; compatible original pixels keep native layout and event metadata
rendering.fonts: Original Lucida Grande UI roles, archived font decoding, CoreText and system font alias
rendering.desktop: Original Dock glass artwork, original illuminated running indicators and live icon reflections; native Dock tiles retain interaction
rendering.controls: Original button, progress, segment, slider, scrollbar and source-list artwork
rendering.materials: Shared non-vibrant surfaces for NSVisualEffectView roles, including original selection artwork; approximate colors for newer roles require visual qualification

resources.localOnly: Apple frameworks, fonts, bitmaps, original Dock images and installer payloads stay in Build
resources.backup: Per-file journals and original bytes inside each disposable guest
resources.applications: Full bundle-identity inventory maps moved and renamed bundles; declared icons and matching resource paths use only exact unique identifiers
resources.catalogInstallation: Transactional replacement with root ownership and console-user readability checks

validation.scope: Equal raw RGBA hashes for the same drawing parameters on Mavericks and Mojave; this does not establish whole-desktop pixel identity

remaining: Visual qualification of all material roles and controls across application states
Full menu-bar material and geometry parity
Finder-specific metrics and source-list focus states
Dock background-window reflections, bounce synchronization and side orientations
Secure-field behavior under the global font alias
Artwork for features introduced after Mavericks
